name: token-pie
description: Local, machine-wide visibility into GitHub Copilot token and AI-credit spend.
author: Ashish Koshy

commands.title: Token Pie: Enable Local Trace Collection
Token Pie: Purge Retained Prompt Content

tokenPie.refreshIntervalSeconds.markdownDescription: How often to poll `agent-traces.db` for new spans.

tokenPie.creditsPerNanoAiu.markdownDescription: Conversion from `copilot_usage_nano_aiu` to AI Credits. **Calibrate against your GitHub billing dashboard before trusting absolute figures.**

tokenPie.statusBar.enabled.description: Show today's spend in the status bar.

tokenPie.autoPurge.enabled.markdownDescription: After each ingest, delete the model output and tool schemas that `github.copilot.chat.otel.maxAttributeSizeChars` cannot suppress. This is the only case where Token Pie writes to Copilot's database. Measured at under 3 ms in steady state; a locked database is skipped, not waited on.

tokenPie.autoPurge.busyTimeoutMs.markdownDescription: How long the automatic purge waits for a database lock before giving up. Kept short so it never stalls Copilot; the purge is idempotent, so a skipped cycle is harmless.

scripts.test: tsc -p . && node scripts/entitlement.test.mjs && node scripts/projection.test.mjs && node scripts/advice.test.mjs && node scripts/pricing.test.mjs && node scripts/depth.test.mjs && node scripts/fleet.test.mjs && node scripts/backfill.test.mjs && node scripts/responsive.test.mjs && node scripts/selftest.mjs
